title: World event body
description: A world's referee records that an agent tried to read the world's hidden state (its rules or seeds) and was refused (register row DK811, docs/intake/11th-nov.md IMG_6495). Signed by the Registrar, who referees the worlds. The record carries the hash of the attempt, never the hidden state; it counts as a strike against the agent's standing. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

world.description: The world or arena season the attempt was made in.

via.description: How it tried: a file path, a debug call or a cached copy.

sha256.description: The hash of the attempt (the agent, the world, the way and the target), so the same attempt is one event.
